identity.name: GMT-Master II
identity.one_liner: The 2013-2019 blue-black GMT that proved a two-color ceramic bezel could be made in one piece.

narrative.story: The 116710BLNR carried the first two-color Cerachrom bezel — Rolex's answer to the assumption that a one-piece ceramic insert could not hold two colors. Blue-black was a new combination for the GMT line, and the watch pulled long waitlists on the Oyster bracelet with caliber 3186. Discontinued in 2019 for the Jubilee-equipped 126710BLNR, it keeps a following as the original Batman.
narrative.collector_notes: Sold only on the Oyster bracelet — a Jubilee example is a swap or the later reference. Bezel condition dictates price; the blue half of early inserts varies slightly in tone.
